newsitem.title: JAPAN: Keisei Electric depressed by Oriental Land auction.
newsitem.headline: Keisei Electric depressed by Oriental Land auction.

text.p: Shares in Keisei Electric Railway Co Ltd were depressed by the market's view that Oriental Land Co Ltd's share auction price could be lower-than-expected, brokers said.

By 0410 GMT, Keisei Electric, a shareholder in Tokyo Disneyland operator Oriental Land, had lost 20 yen to stand at 1,040 yen. Trade volume stood at 2.676, the eighth most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange. Oriental Land is due to go public soon.

"There were initial expectations that the lowest bids would be 10,000 yen at least, but recent speculation is not that optimistic, with the lowest bid said likely to be at the 8,000 level," a "Big Four" broker said.
Oriental Land is due to list on the first section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange on December 11.
